local function ResolveEnhanceValue(raw, level)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return raw
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return nil
    end

    local num = tonumber(s)
    if num then
        return num
    end

    local nums = ParseArray(s)
    if #nums > 0 then
        return nums[math.min(level, #nums)]
    end

    local strs = ParseStringArray(s)
    if #strs > 0 then
        return strs[math.min(level, #strs)]
    end

    return s
end

local function GetEnhanceWeight(cfg)
    local weight = tonumber(cfg and cfg.Weight or 1) or 1
    if weight < 0 then
        weight = 0
    end
    if weight > 1000 then
        weight = 1000
    end
    return weight
end

local function PickWeighted(list, weight_fn)
    if not list or #list == 0 then
        return nil, nil
    end
    local total = 0
    for _, name in ipairs(list) do
        local w = tonumber(weight_fn(name)) or 0
        if w > 0 then
            total = total + w
        end
    end
    if total <= 0 then
        local idx = RandomInt(1, #list)
        return list[idx], idx
    end
    local roll = RandomFloat(0, total)
    local acc = 0
    for i, name in ipairs(list) do
        local w = tonumber(weight_fn(name)) or 0
        if w > 0 then
            acc = acc + w
            if roll <= acc then
                return name, i
            end
        end
    end
    return list[#list], #list
end

local function ParsePercentValue(value)
    if type(value) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end
    local trimmed = string.gsub(value, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
    local num = string.match(trimmed, "^([%-]?%d+%.?%d*)%%%s*$")
    if num then
        return tonumber(num)
    end
    return nil
end

local function ResolveEnhanceDisplayValue(raw, level)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "table" then
        return nil
    end
    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return tostring(raw)
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return nil
    end

    local tokens = ParseStringArray(s)
    if #tokens > 0 then
        return tokens[math.min(level, #tokens)]
    end

    return s
end

local function ResolveEnhanceNumber(raw, level, base_value)
    if raw == nil then
        return nil
    end

    if type(raw) == "number" then
        return raw
    end

    if type(raw) == "string" then
        local token = ResolveEnhanceDisplayValue(raw, level)
        if token ~= nil then
            local percent = ParsePercentValue(token)
            if percent ~= nil then
                local base = tonumber(base_value)
                if base == nil then
                    return nil
                end
                return base * (1 + percent / 100)
            end
            local numeric = tonumber(token)
            if numeric ~= nil then
                return numeric
            end
        end
    end

    local resolved = ResolveEnhanceValue(raw, level)
    if resolved == nil then
        return nil
    end

    local percent = ParsePercentValue(resolved)
    if percent ~= nil then
        local base = tonumber(base_value)
        if base == nil then
            return nil
        end
        return base * (1 + percent / 100)
    end

    if type(resolved) == "string" then
        local numeric = tonumber(resolved)
        if numeric ~= nil then
            return numeric
        end
    end

    return resolved
end

local function SplitByPipe(raw)
    local list = {}
    if raw == nil then
        return list
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    for token in string.gmatch(s, "[^|]+") do
        local trimmed = string.gsub(token, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")
        if trimmed ~= "" then
            table.insert(list, trimmed)
        end
    end
    return list
end

local function NormalizeList(raw)
    if raw == nil then
        return {}
    end
    if type(raw) == "table" then
        local list = {}
        for k, v in pairs(raw) do
            table.insert(list, k)
            if v ~= nil and v ~= "" then
                table.insert(list, v)
            end
        end
        return list
    end
    local s = tostring(raw)
    if s == "" then
        return {}
    end

    local pipe = SplitByPipe(s)
    if #pipe > 0 then
        return pipe
    end

    return { raw }
end

local function GetContextIndexForProjectile(cfg, projectile_name)

local function ApplyEnhanceContext(overrides, cfg, level, context, projectile_name, item_kv, item_level)
    if not overrides or not cfg then
        return
    end

    local idx = GetContextIndexForProjectile(cfg, projectile_name)
    if idx == nil then
        return
    end

    local function set_value(prefix, raw)
        SetOverride(overrides, prefix, GetListValueAt(raw, idx), level)
    end

    local function set_number(prefix, raw)
        local base_value = GetBaseStatValue(item_kv, prefix, item_level, overrides)
        SetOverrideWithBase(overrides, prefix, GetListValueAt(raw, idx), level, base_value)
    end

    if context == "Projectile" then
        set_value("ProjectileName", cfg.Projectile)
        set_number("ProjectileInterval", cfg.ProjectileInterval)
        set_number("ProjectileRange", cfg.ProjectileRange)
        set_number("ProjectileBaseDamage", cfg.ProjectileBaseDamage)
        set_value("ProjectileDamageScale", cfg.ProjectileDamageScale)
        set_value("HealPercent", cfg.HealPercent)
        set_value("PurePercent", cfg.PurePercent)
    else
        local suffix = string.sub(context, string.len("ProjectileSP") + 1)

        set_value(prefix, cfg.Projectile)
        set_number(prefix .. "Interval", cfg.ProjectileInterval)
        set_number(prefix .. "Range", cfg.ProjectileRange)

        set_value(prefix .. "DamageScale", cfg.ProjectileDamageScale)

    end
end

local function IsEmptyValue(value)
    return value == nil or value == "" or value == "none" or value == "0"
end

local function GetHighestProjectileSlotIndex(item_kv, level, overrides)
    local highest = 0
    for i = 1, 10 do
        local suffix = (i == 1) and "" or tostring(i)
        local key = "ProjectileSP" .. suffix
        local val = overrides and overrides[key]
        if val == nil then
            val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        end
        if not IsEmptyValue(val) then
            highest = i
        end
    end
    return highest
end

local function GetNextProjectileSlotKey(item_kv, level, overrides)
    local next_idx = math.max(3, GetHighestProjectileSlotIndex(item_kv, level, overrides) + 1)
    local suffix = (next_idx == 1) and "" or tostring(next_idx)
    return "ProjectileSP" .. suffix, next_idx
end

local function GetNextPassiveSlotKey(item_kv, level, overrides)
    for i = 1, 6 do
        local suffix = (i == 1) and "" or tostring(i)
        local key = "PassiveSP" .. suffix
        local val = overrides and overrides[key]
        if val == nil then
            val = GetItemFieldValue(item_kv, key, level)
        end

        end
    end
    return "PassiveSP3"

            SetOverride(overrides, "ProjectileSP" .. suffix .. "PurePercent",

function Shop1EnhanceManager:HasSourceMatch(item_sources, cfg_sources)
    if not item_sources or not cfg_sources then
        return false
    end
    for _, src in ipairs(cfg_sources) do
        local target = tostring(src)
        if target ~= "" then
            for _, item_src in ipairs(item_sources) do
                if tostring(item_src) == target then
                    return true
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:EnsureState(pid)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return nil
    end
    if not self.states[pid] then
        self.states[pid] = {
            pool_list = {},
            pool_map = {},
            purchased = {},
            selection = nil,
        }
    end
    return self.states[pid]
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:Init()
    if self._event_registered then
        return
    end
    self._event_registered = true

    self:BuildSourceIndex()

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("shop1_enhance_request", function(_, event)
        self:OnEnhanceRequest(event)
    end)

    CustomGameEventManager:RegisterListener("shop1_enhance_choice", function(_, event)
        self:OnEnhanceChoice(event)
    end)

end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:InitPlayer(pid)
    self:EnsureState(pid)
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetPurchasedCount(pid, name)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not name then
        return 0
    end
    return state.purchased[name] or 0
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:SetPurchasedCount(pid, name, count)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not name then
        return
    end
    state.purchased[name] = count
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:AddEnhanceToPool(pid, name)
    local state = self:EnsureState(pid)
    if not state or not name or name == "" or name == "none" then
        return false
    end

    if state.pool_map[name] then
        return false
    end

    local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(name)
    if not self:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg) then
        return false
    end

    local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
    if stacks ~= -1 then
        local purchased = self:GetPurchasedCount(pid, name)
        if purchased >= stacks then
            return false
        end
    end

    table.insert(state.pool_list, name)
    state.pool_map[name] = true
    return true
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:AddEnhancesBySource(pid, source_key)
    local changed = false
    for _, name in ipairs(self:GetEnhancesBySource(source_key)) do
        changed = self:AddEnhanceToPool(pid, name) or changed
    end
    return changed
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:RemoveEnhanceFromPool(pid, name)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not name then
        return false
    end
    if not state.pool_map[name] then
        return false
    end
    state.pool_map[name] = nil

    for i = #state.pool_list, 1, -1 do
        if state.pool_list[i] == name then
            table.remove(state.pool_list, i)
            break
        end
    end
    return true
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetPoolList(pid)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state then
        return {}
    end
    return state.pool_list
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:IsUnlocked(pid)
    if not PlayerResource:IsValidPlayerID(pid) then
        return true
    end
    if not SpawnWallManager or not SpawnWallManager.GetExpansionProgress then

    end
    local _, _, count = SpawnWallManager:GetExpansionProgress(pid)
    count = tonumber(count or 0) or 0
    return count >= 5
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetClientState(pid)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    local pool_count = (state and state.pool_list and #state.pool_list) or 0
    return {

        available = pool_count > 0,

end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:OnItemAcquired(pid, raw_item_name, level)
    if not raw_item_name or raw_item_name == "" then

    if not kv then

    local lvl = tonumber(level or 1) or 1
    local changed = false
    for _, src in ipairs(CollectItemSources(kv, lvl)) do
        changed = self:AddEnhancesBySource(pid, src) or changed
    end

    return changed
end

function Shop1EnhanceManager:GetOverrideValues(pid, raw_item_name, level, kv)
    local state = self.states[pid]
    if not state or not raw_item_name then
        return nil
    end

    local item_kv = kv or (Shop1ItemsKV and Shop1ItemsKV[raw_item_name])
    if not item_kv then
        return nil
    end

    local lvl = tonumber(level or 1) or 1
    local item_sources = CollectItemSources(item_kv, lvl)
    local overrides = {}
    local applied = false
    local applied_extra = {}

    for enhance_name, count in pairs(state.purchased or {}) do
        if count and count > 0 then
            local cfg = self:GetEnhanceConfig(enhance_name)
            if self:IsEnhanceOpen(cfg) then
                local cfg_sources = NormalizeList(cfg.Source)
                if self:HasSourceMatch(item_sources, cfg_sources) then
                    local stacks = self:GetEnhanceStacks(cfg)
                    local enhance_level = (stacks == -1) and count or math.min(count, stacks)
                    for _, slot in ipairs(CollectProjectileSlots(item_kv, lvl)) do

                        ApplyEnhanceExtras(overrides, cfg, enhance_level, item_kv, lvl)
                        ApplyEnhanceEffects(overrides, cfg, enhance_level)

                    end
                    applied = true
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if not applied then
        return nil
    end

    return overrides

    if not cfg then

if projectile_base == nil then
    projectile_base = class({})
end

function projectile_base:OnProjectileThink_ExtraData(pos, data)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not data then return end

    if data.spawn_time and data.max_time then
        if GameRules:GetGameTime() - data.spawn_time >= data.max_time then
            ProjectileManager:DestroyTrackingProjectile(data.projectile_id or -1)
            return
        end
    end

    -- 记录前一帧位置
    if not data.prev_x then
        data.prev_x = pos.x
        data.prev_y = pos.y
        data.prev_z = pos.z
        return
    end

    -- 目标死亡 → 让投射物继续按原来的方向飞
    local target = EntIndexToHScript(data.target_entindex or -1)
    if not target or target:IsNull() or not target:IsAlive() then
        local last = Vector(data.prev_x, data.prev_y, data.prev_z)
        local dir = (pos - last):Normalized()

        -- 保存方向，用于 OnProjectileHit
        data.dir_x = dir.x
        data.dir_y = dir.y
        data.dir_z = dir.z
    end

    -- 保存当前位置用于下帧计算
    data.prev_x = pos.x
    data.prev_y = pos.y
    data.prev_z = pos.z
end

function projectile_base:OnProjectileHit_ExtraData(target, pos, data)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    if not data then return end

    local dummy = EntIndexToHScript(data.dummy_entindex or -1)
    if not dummy or dummy:IsNull() then return end

    local hit_target = nil

    if target and target:IsAlive() then
        hit_target = target
    end

    if not hit_target then
        return true
    end

    dummy:PerformAttack(
        hit_target,
        true,  -- bUseCastAttackOrb
        true,  -- bProcessProcs
        true,  -- bSkipCooldown
        false, -- bIgnoreInvis
        false, -- bUseProjectile (不用单位攻击弹道)
        false, -- bFakeAttack
        true   -- bNeverMiss
    )

    return true
end

return projectile_base

LinkLuaModifier("modifier_dummy_autocast",
    "projectiles/modifier_dummy_autocast.lua", LUA_MODIFIER_MOTION_NONE)

modifier_ability_autocast_controller = class({})

function modifier_ability_autocast_controller:IsHidden() return true end

function modifier_ability_autocast_controller:IsPurgable() return false end

function modifier_ability_autocast_controller:RemoveOnDeath() return false end

function modifier_ability_autocast_controller:GetAttributes()
    return MODIFIER_ATTRIBUTE_MULTIPLE
end

function modifier_ability_autocast_controller:OnCreated()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    local parent  = self:GetParent()

    local ability = self:GetAbility()

    if not ability then return end

    Timers:CreateTimer(0, function()
        local name   = ability:GetAbilityName()

        local raw_kv = ability:GetAbilityKeyValues()
        local type   = 1
        if raw_kv and raw_kv.Shop then
            type = tonumber(raw_kv.Shop)
        end


        local stats_kv = {}
        if type == 1 then
            stats_kv = Shop1ItemsKV[name] or {}
        elseif type == 2 then
            stats_kv = Shop2ItemsKV[name] or {}
        elseif type == 3 then
            stats_kv = Shop3ItemsKV[name] or {}
        elseif type == 0 then
            stats_kv = PersistentItemsKV[name] or {}
        end

        local lvl                   = ability.custom_level
        self.projectile_name        = stats_kv.ProjectileName
        self.passive_name           = stats_kv.PassiveName
        self.projectile_interval    = ParseArray(stats_kv.ProjectileInterval)[lvl]
        self.projectile_range       = ParseArray(stats_kv.ProjectileRange)[lvl]
        self.projectile_base_damage = ParseArray(stats_kv.ProjectileBaseDamage)[lvl]

        --DebugPrint("Ability name", self.projectile_name, "lvl", lvl, "interval", self.projectile_interval)

        if self.projectile_interval <= 0 then
            self.projectile_interval = 2.0
        end
        if self.projectile_range <= 0 then
            self.projectile_range = 800
        end

        self.dummy = CreateUnitByName(
            "npc_dota_auto_cast_dummy",
            Vector(10000, 10000, 0),
            false,
            parent,
            parent,
            parent:GetTeamNumber()
        )

        if not self.dummy then return end

        self.dummy:SetOwner(parent)
        self.dummy:SetControllableByPlayer(parent:GetPlayerOwnerID(), false)
        --self.dummy:FollowEntity(parent, false)

        Timers:CreateTimer(function()
            if not self.dummy or self.dummy:IsNull() then return end

            if not parent or parent:IsNull() or parent.__is_evolving then
                return
            end

            self.dummy:SetAbsOrigin(parent:GetAbsOrigin())
            return 0.03
        end)

        self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, nil, "modifier_invulnerable", {})
        self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, nil, "modifier_phased", {}) -- 无碰撞
        self.dummy:AddNewModifier(self.dummy, nil, "modifier_rooted", {}) -- 不移动（保险）

        -- 给 dummy 挂自动施法 modifier
        self.dummy:AddNewModifier(parent, ability, "modifier_dummy_autocast", {
            projectile_name        = self.projectile_name,
            projectile_interval    = self.projectile_interval,
            projectile_range       = self.projectile_range,
            projectile_base_damage = self.projectile_base_damage,
            passive_name           = self.passive_name,
        })
    end)
end

function modifier_ability_autocast_controller:OnDestroy()
    if not IsServer() then return end

    print("[Modifier OnDestroy]", self:GetName())

    if self.dummy and not self.dummy:IsNull() then
        self.dummy:Destroy()
        self.dummy = nil
    end
end

local M = {}

local HANDLER_PATHS = {
    axe = "projectiles.autocast_specials.axe",
    invoker = "projectiles.autocast_specials.invoker",
    phoenix = "projectiles.autocast_specials.phoenix",
    tiny = "projectiles.autocast_specials.tiny",
}

local handler_cache = {}

function M:GetHandler(key)
    if not key then
        return nil
    end

    if handler_cache[key] then
        return handler_cache[key]
    end

    local path = HANDLER_PATHS[key]
    if not path then
        return nil
    end

    local ok, handler = pcall(require, path)
    if ok and handler then
        handler_cache[key] = handler
        return handler
    end

    return nil
end

return M

local function ReadUnitKV(unit)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then

    end

    if not name or name == "" then

    end

local function ApplyRangedProjectileFromDummy(target, source)

    end

**Assessing enhancement passives**

Enhancements currently add passives to a dummy unit via the enhance config’s Passive list, not directly to heroes. There’s no existing support to add hero passives in the enhancement manager, so adding new ability passives may involve attaching them to dummy units unless new hero passive support is implemented.

**Designing layered passive enhancements**

I'm outlining a design where new passive effects are implemented as ability_lua on dummy units with enhancement config managing their levels via PassiveLevel or adding separate abilities for upgrades. Current enhancement logic adds new passive slots but lacks support to adjust existing passive levels, so extending the manager to override passive ability levels or use ability upgrades will be needed for advanced effects.

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:IsHidden() return true end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:IsPurgable() return false end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:RemoveOnDeath() return false end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:CheckState()
    return {
        [MODIFIER_STATE_NO_HEALTH_BAR] = true,
    }
end

local function GetCacheValue(modifier, key)
    if IsServer() then
        return (modifier.final_cache_server and modifier.final_cache_server[key]) or 0
    end
    return (modifier.final_cache and modifier.final_cache[key]) or 0
end

local function SyncUnitBasics(unit, source)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if not source or source:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    if unit.SetBaseAttackTime and source.GetBaseAttackTime then
        unit:SetBaseAttackTime(source:GetBaseAttackTime())
    end
    if unit.SetAttackCapability and source.GetAttackCapability then
        unit:SetAttackCapability(source:GetAttackCapability())
    end
end

local function ResolveAttackRange(unit, source, range)
    local final = range or 0
    if final <= 0 then
        if source and source.GetAttackRange then
            final = source:GetAttackRange() or 0
        elseif unit and unit.GetAttackRange then
            final = unit:GetAttackRange() or 0
        end
    end
    if final <= 0 then
        final = 150
    end
    return final
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:ApplyAttackOverride(modifier, unit, source, range, interval)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    SyncUnitBasics(unit, source)
    if modifier and modifier.UpdateAttackStats then
        local final_range = ResolveAttackRange(unit, source, range)
        modifier:UpdateAttackStats(final_range, interval)
    end
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:ApplyAttackRangeOverride(modifier, unit, source, range)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    SyncUnitBasics(unit, source)
    if modifier and modifier.UpdateAttackRange then
        local final_range = ResolveAttackRange(unit, source, range)
        modifier:UpdateAttackRange(final_range)
    end
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:ApplyAttackSpeedOverride(modifier, unit, source, interval)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    SyncUnitBasics(unit, source)
    if modifier and modifier.UpdateAttackSpeedOnly then
        modifier:UpdateAttackSpeedOnly(interval)
    end
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:ApplyCastRangeOverride(modifier, final_range, base_cast_range, padding)
    if not modifier or modifier:IsNull() then
        return
    end
    local desired = final_range or 0
    local base = base_cast_range or 0
    local pad = padding or 0
    local bonus = math.max(desired + pad - base, 0)
    modifier:UpdateCastRangeBonus(bonus)
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:OnCreated(kv)
    if not IsServer() then return end
    self.parent = self:GetParent()
    self.prevent_death = kv and kv.prevent_death or nil
    self.final_cache_server = {}
    self:SetHasCustomTransmitterData(true)
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:UpdateAttackStats(range, interval)
    if not IsServer() then return end

    local bat = self.parent and self.parent:GetBaseAttackTime() or 1.7
    if not bat or bat <= 0 then
        bat = 1.7
    end

    local atk_speed = 0
    if interval and interval > 0 then
        atk_speed = (bat / interval - 1) * 100
    end

    self.final_cache_server = self.final_cache_server or {}
    self.final_cache_server.AttackRange = range or 0
    self.final_cache_server.AttackSpeed = atk_speed
    self:SendBuffRefreshToClients()
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:UpdateAttackRange(range)

    self.final_cache_server = self.final_cache_server or {}
    self.final_cache_server.AttackRange = range or 0
    self:SendBuffRefreshToClients()
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:UpdateAttackSpeedOnly(interval)
    if not IsServer() then return end

    if not bat or bat <= 0 then

    end

    end

    self.final_cache_server.AttackSpeed = atk_speed
    self:SendBuffRefreshToClients()
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:UpdateCastRangeBonus(bonus)

    self.final_cache_server.CastRangeBonus = bonus or 0
    self:SendBuffRefreshToClients()
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:GetAttributes()
    return MODIFIER_ATTRIBUTE_MULTIPLE
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:DeclareFunctions()

        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_ATTACKSPEED_BONUS_CONSTANT,
        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_CAST_RANGE_BONUS_STACKING,
        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_MIN_HEALTH,
        MODIFIER_PROPERTY_HEALTH_REGEN_PERCENTAGE
    }
end

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:GetModifierAttackRangeOverride()

function modifier_autocast_dummy_attrs:GetModifierAttackSpeedBonus_Constant()

local M = {}

local default_stats = {}

function M.HasBehavior(behavior, flag)
    return behavior and string.find(behavior, flag, 1, true)
end

function M.ResolveCastBehavior(ability_kv)
    local behavior = ability_kv and ability_kv.AbilityBehavior or ""
    if M.HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_POINT") then
        return "Position"
    end

    if M.HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_UNIT_TARGET") then
        local target_team = ability_kv and ability_kv.AbilityUnitTargetTeam or ""
        if M.HasBehavior(target_team, "DOTA_UNIT_TARGET_TEAM_FRIENDLY") then
            return "Self"
        end
        return "Target"
    end

    if M.HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET") then
        return "NoTarget"
    end

    return "NoTarget"
end

function M.ParseAbilityCastRange(ability_kv, level)
    if not ability_kv then
        return 0
    end
    local cast_range = ability_kv.AbilityCastRange
    if type(cast_range) == "number" then
        return cast_range
    end
    if type(cast_range) == "string" and cast_range ~= "" then
        local nums = ParseArray(cast_range)
        if #nums > 0 then
            local idx = math.max(level or 1, 1)
            idx = math.min(idx, #nums)
            return tonumber(nums[idx]) or 0
        end
        local first = string.match(cast_range, "[-%d%.]+")
        return tonumber(first) or 0
    end
    return 0
end

function M.ParseAbilityDuration(ability_kv)
    if not ability_kv then
        return 0
    end
    local dur = ability_kv.AbilityDuration
    if type(dur) == "number" then
        return dur
    end
    if type(dur) == "string" and dur ~= "" then
        local first = string.match(dur, "[-%d%.]+")
        return tonumber(first) or 0
    end
    return 0
end

function M.GetAbilityCastRange(profile, pos, owner)
    if not profile or not profile.skill then
        return 0
    end
    local ability = profile.skill
    local level = 1
    if ability.GetLevel then
        level = math.max(ability:GetLevel(), 1)
    end
    return M.ParseAbilityCastRange(profile.skill_kv or ability:GetAbilityKeyValues(), level)
end

function M.ActivatePassiveAbility(parent, ability, use_direct_cast)
    if not parent or not ability or ability:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    local ability_kv = ability:GetAbilityKeyValues() or {}
    local behavior = ability_kv.AbilityBehavior or ""

    if M.HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_TOGGLE") or M.HasBehavior(behavior, "TOGGLE") then
        ability:ToggleAbility()
        return
    end

    if M.HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_AUTOCAST") or M.HasBehavior(behavior, "AUTOCAST") then
        if not ability:GetAutoCastState() then
            ability:ToggleAutoCast()
        end
        return
    end

    if M.HasBehavior(behavior, "DOTA_ABILITY_BEHAVIOR_NO_TARGET") or M.HasBehavior(behavior, "NO_TARGET") then
        if use_direct_cast then
            parent:CastAbilityNoTarget(ability, parent:GetPlayerID())
        else
            ExecuteOrderFromTable({
                UnitIndex = parent:entindex(),
                OrderType = DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET,
                AbilityIndex = ability:entindex(),
                Queue = false,
            })
        end
    end
end

function M.IsUnitBusy(unit)
    if not unit or unit:IsNull() then
        return false
    end
    if unit.__tiny_grab_busy then
        return true
    end

    local function IsFreezingFieldWithScepterActive()
        if not unit.GetCurrentActiveAbility or not unit.HasModifier then
            return false
        end

        local ability = unit:GetCurrentActiveAbility()
        if not ability or ability:IsNull() then
            return false
        end

        if ability:GetAbilityName() ~= "crystal_maiden_freezing_field" then
            return false
        end

        -- Aghanim allows full action during channel
        return unit:HasModifier("modifier_item_ultimate_scepter")
    end

    -- Channeling normally blocks everything
    if unit.IsChanneling and unit:IsChanneling() then
        if not IsFreezingFieldWithScepterActive() then
            return true
        end
    end

    -- CastPoint (ability windup) always blocks
    if unit.IsCastingAbility and unit:IsCastingAbility() then
        return true
    end

    -- AttackPoint (attack windup) blocks
    if unit.IsAttacking and unit:IsAttacking() then
        if unit.IsPerformingAttack and unit:IsPerformingAttack() then
            return true
        end
    end

    return false
end


function M.GetPlayerStats(owner)
    if not owner or owner:IsNull() or (not owner:IsRealHero()) then
        return default_stats
    end

    local pid = owner:GetPlayerOwnerID()
    if not pid or pid < 0 then
        return default_stats
    end

    local stats = PlayerStats and PlayerStats:GetFinal(pid) or nil
    if not stats then
        return default_stats
    end

    return PlayerStats:GetFinal(pid)
end

function M.NormalizeName(value)
    if value and value ~= "" and value ~= "none" then
        return value
    end
    return nil
end

function M.ToNumber(value)
    if value == nil or value == "" then
        return nil
    end
    return tonumber(value)
end

return M

看过现有实现后，我对结构的理解是：`shop1_items_enhance.txt` 提供强化配置，`shop1_enhance_manager.lua` 根据 `Source`/`Stacks`/`Projectile*`/`Passive` 等字段生成 overrides，然后 `modifier_item_autocast_controller.lua` 把 overrides 合并到物品能力 KV，最后 `modifier_dummy_autocast.lua` 负责创建投射物/施法并给 dummy 挂被动（`PassiveSP/PassiveSP2/PassiveSP3+`）。因此“新增不能直接用 Dota2 现成能力实现的效果”可以通过新增 `ability_lua` 被动并在增强中通过 `Passive` 添加到 dummy（或 hero）来实现。

为了确认设计和实现路径，有几个关键问题需要你确认：

- 这些新被动最终要挂到哪类单位上？只是 `modifier_dummy_autocast` 的 dummy，还是也需要挂到英雄本体（`HeroPassive`/`HeroModifier` 目前未在强化中支持）？
- 每个效果的精确定义和触发点：  
  - `穿透箭矢`：是“命中后继续沿原方向飞行并命中下一个单位”，还是“穿透多个目标”？目标筛选/最大次数/是否命中同一目标多次？作用于哪些 projectile 槽（基础 `ProjectileName` 还是也包括 `ProjectileSP`）？  
  - `爆炸箭矢`：爆炸半径、伤害类型、是否吃 `ProjectileDamageScale`/`PurePercent`、是否对主目标重复结算？  
  - `弹簧箭矢`：当前项目里有“墙体/碰撞”判定吗？如果没有，是打算用 NavMesh/阻挡体/自定义边界来判定反弹？  
  - `次级飞刃`：是否在命中首个单位后“自动寻找附近目标”还是“固定角度分裂”？范围/优先级/找不到目标时的行为？  
  - `爆炸飞刃/锋利飞刃`：是对“飞刃本身”还是对“基础箭矢+飞刃”分别生效？
- 进阶强化的“最优方案”偏好：  
  1) 同一能力多级（通过 `PassiveLevel`/`Stacks` 控制）  
  2) 新能力名（`drow_ranger_explode_2` 等）  
  3) 同名被动 + 额外 modifier（叠加或替换）  
  目前 `ApplyEnhanceExtras` 只能“新增被动槽”，不会直接覆盖已有 `PassiveSPLevel`；如果用“多级同能力”，需要确保高级强化把同名被动再加一次（靠更高 Level 覆盖），或者扩展增强逻辑来支持覆盖现有等级。你倾向哪一种？
- 新能力 KV/脚本的落点：你更希望我把新 `ability_lua` 定义放在 `game/dzsj/scripts/npc/npc_abilities_custom.txt`，还是放在 `game/dzsj/scripts/npc/abilities/` 并通过你现有的 KV 同步流程合入？（我看到 `shop1_items_raw.txt` 是独立文件，想确认你现在的构建/同步方式。）

确认这些后，我再给出具体方案并开始改代码。

# DZSJ KV Sync (Go CLI)

轻量化重构，去掉 VSCode 插件 / Electron，仅保留可直接运行的 CLI 与最终单一 exe。业务逻辑与原版保持一致（KV 同步、AbilityValues 构建、本地化扩展、派生 item 生成）。

## 开发方式（无需打包）
- 依赖：Go 1.22（本仓示例使用 `D:\PVE\tools\go\bin`）。
- 直接运行源码：在仓库上层目录（包含 `dzsj.kv-sync.json` 的根）执行：
  ```powershell
  $env:PATH="D:\PVE\tools\go\bin;$env:PATH"
  go run ./cmd/dzsj-kv-sync --root .
  ```
  未指定 `--root` 时默认取当前目录，自动递归寻找 `dzsj.kv-sync.json`。
- VSCode 任务：`kv-sync: run (dev)`（cwd 指向仓库上层）。

## 发布方式（生成 exe）
- 运行脚本：
  ```powershell
  ./scripts/build-release.ps1
  ```
  使用 `-trimpath -ldflags "-s -w"`，输出 `game/dzsj/excel/dzsj-kv-sync.exe`。
- 体积：当前构建约 **2.21 MB**（对比旧 Electron exe 83 MB+）。未内置 UPX，若需进一步压缩可自行对生成的 exe 使用 UPX。
- VSCode 任务：`kv-sync: build release exe`。

## 设计与取舍
- 语言：Go，单一二进制，无 Node/Electron/VSCode 扩展依赖。
- 数据结构：自实现 KV 解析与有序写回，保留原有字段顺序与特殊规则（含 `Shop` 派生始终为 `-1`）。
- 功能：保留全部同步流程（AbilityValues 重建、BonusAttribute 注入、等级派生、Lua 复制、本地化扩展与清理）。
- 运行根目录：仍通过 `dzsj.kv-sync.json` 驱动，路径按配置相对定位。

    if base_phys_damage <= 0 then return 0 end

    local armor = victim:GetPhysicalArmorValue(false) or 0

    -- 护甲穿透（攻击方）
    local pierce = 0
    if atk_stats then
        pierce = atk_stats.game_final.ArmorPierce or 0
    end

    local armor_eff = armor - pierce

    -- Dota 物理减伤公式：0.06 * armor / (1 + 0.06 * armor)
    local reduction = 0
    if armor_eff >= 0 then
        reduction = 0.06 * armor_eff / (1 + 0.06 * armor_eff)
    else
        reduction = 0.06 * armor_eff / (1 - 0.06 * armor_eff) -- 负护甲增伤
    end

    local after = base_phys_damage * (1 - reduction)
    return after
end

    if base_mag_damage <= 0 then return 0 end

    local resist = victim:Script_GetMagicalArmorValue(false, nil) or 0

    if resist > 0.95 then resist = 0.95 end
    if resist < -0.99 then resist = -0.99 end

    local after = base_mag_damage * (1 - resist)
    return after
end

payload.text:
**Planning piercing projectile effect**

The attack events are triggered by a dummy attacker using PerformAttack, so hooking OnAttackLanded on the dummy modifier can enable extra projectile logic. To create piercing, a new linear projectile can be spawned at hit location continuing toward the original direction computed from attacker to target, with consistent damage and controlled pierce count.

**Clarifying enhancement abilities design and parameters**

The planned design uses separate passive abilities per enhancement and upgrades, with base ability modifiers reading upgrade values to combine effects simply. Before implementation, I’ll ask about how to link enhancements in shop1_items_enhance.txt, confirm effect parameters (pierce counts, damage penalties, ranges, speeds, explosion radius), boundary data for spring arrows, knife attack details, upgrade handling preferences, visibility of abilities, compatibility with existing abilities, file structure conventions, and localization strategy.

我看完了当前架构和你新增的约束，确认几点现状：

- `game/dzsj/scripts/npc/abilities/shop1_items_abilities_enhance.txt` 现在是空文件，而且没有被代码直接引用；不过 `dzsj-kv-sync` 会把 `game/dzsj/scripts/npc/abilities/` 目录下的所有 KV 合并进 `npc_abilities_custom.txt`，所以把新能力 KV 放这里是可行的。
- 强化挂在 autocast dummy 上、并需要对 clone/dummy_sp 一致生效，这一点目前通过 `modifier_dummy_autocast` 的 `__autocast_additional_passives` 已经能同步到 clone（dummy_sp 主要负责施法，不吃被动也没问题）。

在开始设计/改代码前，还需要你确认/补充这些关键点（否则无法定数值和实现细节）：

**必须确认的数值与细节**
- 穿透箭矢：每级穿透次数具体是多少？“伤害 -20%”是对所有命中统一减 20%，还是仅对穿透后的追加命中减？如果有进阶版（如 +1 穿透），是否只改穿透次数，不改伤害惩罚？
- 爆炸箭矢：爆炸半径、额外伤害量/倍率、伤害类型（物理/魔法/纯粹），以及是否吃 `ProjectileDamageScale` 与 `PurePercent`？
- 重型爆炸箭：只提高爆炸伤害倍率（比如 *2.6），还是也改半径？
- 弹簧箭矢：反弹次数、每次反弹的伤害是否衰减？  
  墙体位置请给出坐标或配置来源（我可以放到 ability KV 的 `AbilityValues` 里做可配置，但需要你给默认值，比如 left/right/top/bottom）。
- 次级飞刃：生成数量（你之前写 2 个，确认），搜索半径、目标优先级（最近/最低血/随机），飞刃速度，飞刃是否能命中同一目标多次？
- 爆炸飞刃 / 锋利飞刃：  
  - 爆炸飞刃的半径与伤害倍率  
  - 锋利飞刃是“飞刃伤害 +100%”还是“额外倍率 +100%”（即 *2）？

**设计方案确认（建议）**
- 我建议：  
  - 每个“基础效果”做成一个被动 ability + intrinsic modifier（负责实际逻辑）。  
  - “进阶强化”做成单独的 ability，只提供数值；基础能力在触发时 `FindAbilityByName` 读取这些数值。  
  这样配置最简单、代码最少、也避免多份 modifier 重复触发。  
  你确认这种方案吗？

**绑定方式确认**
- 强化的“附加被动”仍然通过 `shop1_items_enhance.txt` 的 `Passive` 字段添加对吧？  
  还是你希望新增一个“只从 `shop1_items_abilities_enhance.txt` 自动注入”的机制？  
  目前系统没有自动注入能力的路径，所以如果不改机制，就需要在 `shop1_items_enhance.txt` 里加 `Passive`。

**本地化策略**
- 你要“描述本地化最便捷”。我建议继续用 `shop1_items_enhance.txt` 的 Name/Desc + `addon_schinese.txt` 的 `#shop1_enhance_xxx_name/desc`。  
  这些能力本身是隐藏被动，能力 tooltip 不需要。可以确认？

你把上面问题的数值/选择确定后，我就开始给出详细设计与改代码清单，然后再动手改。

**Considering approaches to explosion damage handling**

Exploring options to integrate explosion damage with existing damage filters by leveraging or mimicking dummy cast modifiers, custom abilities marked as skills, or adjusting profiles; leaning toward reusing damage system by setting victim fields and applying damage from a real attacker without dummy autocast modifiers to avoid profile overrides.

**Refining attacker and damage profile logic**

Decided to use the hero as attacker for applying explosion and knife damage to avoid damage filter overrides by dummy autocast modifier, ensuring correct stat and credit attribution. Planning to compute damage using projectile damage formulas with custom scales independent of profiles, while handling pierce and knife effects via linear and tracking projectiles, and considering modifier adjustments to scale damage consistently across dummies and clones.

**Planning passive effects and damage application logic**

Decided to add passives to dummy_sp to match main dummy behavior and avoid recursive pierce triggers by applying damage directly instead of PerformAttack. Will use hero as attacker for custom explosion and knife damage to bypass damage filter overrides while applying scaled damage based on ability specials. Planning a shared helper to resolve owner hero and apply projectile-type damage consistently, with pierce using adjusted attack profile damage scale and linear projectiles to handle multiple hits.

**Designing scalable damage modifiers and multi-ability synergy**

Planning to implement damage scale multipliers applied cumulatively via modifier_dummy_autocast for pierce, spring, and similar effects, managing them with keys to avoid stacking issues. Will extend dummy_sp handling by setting `__autocast_attack_profile` to ensure damage filter applies profile scaling consistently across clones. Bounce mechanics planned using configurable wall bounds and reflection logic to spawn additional hits on targets post-impact, with damage scaling adjusted accordingly.

## Skills
A skill is a set of local instructions to follow that is stored in a `SKILL.md` file. Below is the list of skills that can be used. Each entry includes a name, description, and file path so you can open the source for full instructions when using a specific skill.
### Available skills
- skill-creator: Guide for creating effective skills. This skill should be used when users want to create a new skill (or update an existing skill) that extends Codex's capabilities with specialized knowledge, workflows, or tool integrations. (file: C:/Users/ym199/.codex/skills/.system/skill-creator/SKILL.md)
- skill-installer: Install Codex skills into $CODEX_HOME/skills from a curated list or a GitHub repo path. Use when a user asks to list installable skills, install a curated skill, or install a skill from another repo (including private repos). (file: C:/Users/ym199/.codex/skills/.system/skill-installer/SKILL.md)
### How to use skills
- Discovery: The list above is the skills available in this session (name + description + file path). Skill bodies live on disk at the listed paths.
- Trigger rules: If the user names a skill (with `$SkillName` or plain text) OR the task clearly matches a skill's description shown above, you must use that skill for that turn. Multiple mentions mean use them all. Do not carry skills across turns unless re-mentioned.
- Missing/blocked: If a named skill isn't in the list or the path can't be read, say so briefly and continue with the best fallback.
- How to use a skill (progressive disclosure):
  1) After deciding to use a skill, open its `SKILL.md`. Read only enough to follow the workflow.
  2) If `SKILL.md` points to extra folders such as `references/`, load only the specific files needed for the request; don't bulk-load everything.
  3) If `scripts/` exist, prefer running or patching them instead of retyping large code blocks.
  4) If `assets/` or templates exist, reuse them instead of recreating from scratch.
- Coordination and sequencing:
  - If multiple skills apply, choose the minimal set that covers the request and state the order you'll use them.
  - Announce which skill(s) you're using and why (one short line). If you skip an obvious skill, say why.
- Context hygiene:
  - Keep context small: summarize long sections instead of pasting them; only load extra files when needed.
  - Avoid deep reference-chasing: prefer opening only files directly linked from `SKILL.md` unless you're blocked.
  - When variants exist (frameworks, providers, domains), pick only the relevant reference file(s) and note that choice.
- Safety and fallback: If a skill can't be applied cleanly (missing files, unclear instructions), state the issue, pick the next-best approach, and continue.

local function BuildExtraSet(state)
    local set = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(state.extra_cols or {}) do
        set[key] = true
    end
    return set
end

function SpawnWallManager:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
    if GameState.spawn_points[pid] then
        return GameState.spawn_points[pid]
    end

    local points = {
        good = {},
        bad = {},
        good_keys = {},
        bad_keys = {},
    }

    for i = 1, 7, 1 do
        local good_name = "spawn_point_" .. i
        local bad_name = "monster_spawn_point_" .. i
        local good_point = Entities:FindByName(nil, good_name)
        local bad_point = Entities:FindByName(nil, bad_name)
        if good_point then
            local idx = good_point:GetEntityIndex()
            points.good[idx] = good_point:GetAbsOrigin()
            table.insert(points.good_keys, idx)
        end
        if bad_point then
            local idx = bad_point:GetEntityIndex()
            points.bad[idx] = bad_point:GetAbsOrigin()
            table.insert(points.bad_keys, idx)
        end
    end

    GameState.spawn_points[pid] = points
    return points
end

function SpawnWallManager:EnsureBaseWalls(pid, hero)
    local points = self:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
    if not points then
        return
    end

    if not GameState.walls[pid] then
        GameState.walls[pid] = {}
    end

    for key, value in pairs(points.bad) do
        local existing = GameState.walls[pid][key]
        local wall = existing and EntIndexToHScript(existing) or nil
        if wall and IsValidEntity(wall) then
            if hero and not hero:IsNull() then
                wall:SetOwner(hero)
            end
        else
            local pos = Vector(value.x, 200, 40)
            wall = CreateUnitByName("npc_dota_wall_dummy", pos, false, hero, hero, DOTA_TEAM_GOODGUYS)
            if wall then
                wall:SetHullRadius(125)
                wall:AddNoDraw()
                wall:AddNewModifier(wall, nil, "modifier_phased", {})
                wall:AddNewModifier(wall, nil, "modifier_rooted", {})
                wall.transfer_damage = true
                if hero and not hero:IsNull() then
                    wall:SetOwner(hero)
                end
                wall.wall_owner_pid = pid
                GameState.walls[pid][key] = wall:GetEntityIndex()
            end
        end
    end
end

function SpawnWallManager:InitPlayer(pid, hero)
    local points = self:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
    if not points then
        return
    end

    if not hero or hero:IsNull() then
        return
    end

    self:EnsureBaseWalls(pid, hero)

    local state = EnsureWallState(pid)
    for key, pos in pairs(points.bad) do
        state.base_positions[key] = Vector(pos.x, 200, 40)
    end
    for key, pos in pairs(points.good) do
        state.good_base_positions[key] = Vector(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z)
    end
end

local function FindIndexByKey(list, key)
    if not list then
        return nil
    end
    for i, value in ipairs(list) do
        if value == key then
            return i
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function SpawnWallManager:AddExtraGoodSlot(pid, bad_key, count)
    local points = self:EnsureSpawnPoints(pid)
    if not points or not points.bad_keys or not points.good_keys then
        return
    end

    local idx = FindIndexByKey(points.bad_keys, bad_key)
    if not idx then
        return
    end

+        local radius = 400
+        local mult = 1
+        local hits_target = 1
+        local explode = source:FindAbilityByName("drow_ranger_explode")
+        if explode then
+            radius = tonumber(explode:GetSpecialValueFor("explosion_radius") or 0) or radius
+            mult = tonumber(explode:GetSpecialValueFor("explosion_damage_mult") or 0) or mult
+            hits_target = tonumber(explode:GetSpecialValueFor("explosion_hits_target") or 0) or hits_target
+        end

+        if bonus then

+            mult = mult * (1 + add)
+        end

+            owner:GetTeamNumber(),
+            target:GetAbsOrigin(),
